energyProfile.title: Energy management
energyProfile.hint: Declare this equipment as a flexible load so the surplus arbiter can grant it solar capacity. Enabling changes nothing until the arbiter is switched on in Settings.
arbiter.title: Surplus arbiter
arbiter.hint: One arbiter shares the solar surplus across your flexible loads, in your priority order. Recipes request capacity; you own the order.
arbiter.priorityTitle: Priority: the top load gets the surplus first, the bottom one is switched off first.
arbiter.noProfiles: No flexible loads declared yet. Enable "Flexible load" on an equipment page.
arbiter.settings.engageMarginWHelp: Surplus safety margin the arbiter keeps in reserve before granting more capacity (watts). Higher grants later but imports less from the grid.
arbiter.settings.engageHoldSHelp: How long surplus must stay available before the arbiter grants a load (seconds). Higher ignores brief spikes.
arbiter.settings.releaseHoldSHelp: How long surplus must stay below a grant's need before the arbiter revokes it (seconds). Higher means fewer on/off cycles.
arbiter.settings.smoothingSHelp: Averaging window applied to the grid meter reading (seconds). Higher smooths noise but reacts slower.
arbiter.settings.overrideTtlSHelp: How long a manual action on a load pauses the arbiter for that load (seconds) before automatic control resumes.
arbiter.settings.staleAfterSHelp: If the grid meter sends nothing for this long, the arbiter treats its data as stale and stops granting (seconds).
arbiter.settings.divergenceConfirmSHelp: How long a load's real state must contradict the arbiter's decision before it backs off, assuming someone used a wall switch (seconds).
arbiter.surfaceHint: Who receives the solar surplus right now, and why.
arbiter.kind.revoke-not-honored: did not switch off when asked
arbiter.kind.comfort-off-after-revoke: comfort load switched off on revoke
arbiter.kind.watts-divergence: measured power differs from the set value
arbiter.waitReason.unresponsive: did not respond to the last revoke
energyProfile.completeToEnable: Set a class and a nominal power to enable this load.
energyProfile.classHelp: Deferrable: can be switched off and run later on the surplus (pool pump, water heater). Comfort: runs on demand and the surplus only tops it up; the arbiter never switches it off (air conditioning).
energyProfile.removeConfirm: Remove this flexible-load setup? Its measured power estimate will be lost.
arbiter.noGridMeter: The arbiter needs your main energy meter (grid). Create a Main Energy Meter equipment first.
arbiter.timelineLabel: Arbitration timeline: when each load held the surplus, and when it was stepped back.
arbiter.degradedReason: Meter data is stale. The arbiter is paused until fresh readings arrive.
